hints: You are ordering points by distance. Is the square root doing any work in that comparison?
None: `sqrt` is increasing, so comparing `x² + y²` gives the same order - in exact integers, with no rounding to worry about.
Now it is a top-k question. A max-heap holding the `k` best so far lets each new point be compared against the worst kept one in O(log k).
Sorting everything is O(n log n) and correct. Quickselect averages O(n). The heap is the one that works when the points arrive as a stream.
